body:
It's true that domain registration is live for .neatuser domains on a first come first serve basis. Anybody that wants one, can DM me for tokens. (You'd have to send me your $Neat address, it starts with a 5) 
.neat and .neatuser domains are stored directly on chain. .neat domains will be auctioned off using the candle auction system.
It's not quite clear how .net; .org etc. domains can be registered without duplication issues. Unfortunately Wei hasn't had the time lately to work on this. 

Another thing is that in order to see the website people need to change their browser settings. HNS domains are supported by Chrome and other browsers, Neatcoin ones not at this stage.

Neatcoin domains cost 50 $Neat, the UI still needs updating, but the cost were changed per referendum.

Another competitor that will come on the scene within Dotsama, is Subsocial. They have announced doing domain names.
Great work - chat to [@Junte](/edgeware/account/hX8eTbsDWPsEtoWBSjMBmRg3xXkhd2zxVAoBfGjhp57VPtm) about neatcoin :) will introduce you
